name: host-templates-examples-and-module-isolation
changes: Added ForsettiHostTemplate public contracts and implementation for host state, controller, bootstrap, overlay routing, and surface-state adaptation.
Added Platform view factory registry contracts and implementation with manifest-declared view ID enforcement and duplicate ownership checks.
Split the combined example module target into isolated service, UI, and app module targets.
Added a downstream samples/ForsettiDemo composition root that composes public framework and example targets.
Added Windows starter templates for service, UI, app, shared database, and host composition.
Removed the old combined ForsettiModulesExample implementation and manifests.

validation.command: python3 JSON parse over repository JSON files
python3 manifest validation over src/templates/samples/tests ForsettiManifests

knownLimitations: HostTemplate, demo, templates, and split examples require native Windows/MSVC build validation.
